observation.command: sh -c 'echo "deb http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt jammy-pgdg main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list' && wget --quiet -O - https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/postgresql.gpg && apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -2; apt-cache policy postgresql-15 2>/dev/null | head -4
